# task\-shared\-ledger\-main\-worktree — Resolve linked worktrees to the main worktree's ledger when the project declares it
status: done  priority: 2  scope: scope-git
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_done
commits: a2f9115

Agents running in linked Git worktrees discover the worktree's own tracked copy of \.waystation/ and write claims, messages and status changes into a branch\-local snapshot that other agents never see\. WAYSTATION\_ROOT fixes this but is opt\-in per agent and fails silently when forgotten\. Add a project\-level config setting git\.ledger\_root \("checkout" default \| "main\_worktree"\)\. When upward discovery finds a ledger whose config declares main\_worktree and the discovered directory is a linked worktree, resolve to the main worktree's ledger instead\. \-\-root and WAYSTATION\_ROOT still take precedence\. A missing main\-worktree ledger or a bare repository is a ledger\_not\_found error, never a fallback to the branch\-local copy\. Record the decision in an ADR that amends ADR\-0003\.

## Acceptance
- resolveLedgerRoot redirects a linked worktree to the main worktree's ledger only when the discovered config declares git\.ledger\_root = main\_worktree\.
- Default \(no setting or "checkout"\) behavior is unchanged; \-\-root and WAYSTATION\_ROOT still win\.
- A declared redirect whose main worktree has no ledger, or whose repository is bare, fails with LedgerResolutionError rather than falling back\.
- Tests cover redirect, default, precedence and failure cases with a real git worktree fixture\.
- An ADR amending ADR\-0003 records the decision; README and docs/mcp\.md describe the setting\.
- bun test, typecheck, biome check and waystation validate are clean\.
